why:
A1 [U]: The saved primary-source review was unavailable or could not establish one dataset release; inventory-only claims were not promoted to supported evidence. Release/dataset identity is unresolved or the source evidence was not available.

A2 [U]: The saved primary-source review was unavailable or could not establish one dataset release; inventory-only claims were not promoted to supported evidence. A usable route to the assessed release is not established by the available source snapshot.

A3 [U]: The saved primary-source review was unavailable or could not establish one dataset release; inventory-only claims were not promoted to supported evidence. Release-specific data terms are not established; code-license tags, missing terms and unspecified licenses are insufficient.

L1 [U]: The saved primary-source review was unavailable or could not establish one dataset release; inventory-only claims were not promoted to supported evidence. Complete delivered target meaning/schema is not established for the assessed release; an intended task or title alone is insufficient.

L2 [U]: The saved primary-source review was unavailable or could not establish one dataset release; inventory-only claims were not promoted to supported evidence. The source packet does not jointly establish a target encoding and basic labeling/measurement procedure.

L4 [U]: The saved primary-source review was unavailable or could not establish one dataset release; inventory-only claims were not promoted to supported evidence. No concrete target-review/correction/verification practice is established; multiple annotators, publication, file availability or generic quality claims alone do not qualify.

D1 [U]: The saved primary-source review was unavailable or could not establish one dataset release; inventory-only claims were not promoted to supported evidence. File meanings, relevant units/missing codes or image-to-target mapping remain insufficiently documented.

D2 [U]: The saved primary-source review was unavailable or could not establish one dataset release; inventory-only claims were not promoted to supported evidence. The collector/compiler and collection method or specific parent lineage remain insufficiently established.

D4 [U]: The saved primary-source review was unavailable or could not establish one dataset release; inventory-only claims were not promoted to supported evidence. No dataset-specific author-reported use boundary, exclusion or limitation is established; reviewer criticism of missing metadata does not qualify.

C1 [U]: The saved primary-source review was unavailable or could not establish one dataset release; inventory-only claims were not promoted to supported evidence. The exact released sample count and its unit remain unreported or not verified against the selected release.

C2 [U]: The saved primary-source review was unavailable or could not establish one dataset release; inventory-only claims were not promoted to supported evidence. Quantitative task-relevant class, outcome or subset accounting is not established; a total/class-list alone is insufficient.

R1 [U]: The saved primary-source review was unavailable or could not establish one dataset release; inventory-only claims were not promoted to supported evidence. Collection geography/site, pavement context or capture setting is missing or unresolved; author affiliation is not collection geography.

R2 [U]: The saved primary-source review was unavailable or could not establish one dataset release; inventory-only claims were not promoted to supported evidence. Relevant collection variation or a meaningful explicit collection boundary is not established.

M1 [U]: The saved primary-source review was unavailable or could not establish one dataset release; inventory-only claims were not promoted to supported evidence. Collection platform/sensor or data-generation method is unreported or only inferred from the title.

M2 [U]: The saved primary-source review was unavailable or could not establish one dataset release; inventory-only claims were not promoted to supported evidence. Task-relevant resolution/sampling/measurement units are absent or only generically described; physical scale does not substitute for unspecified image dimensions in the image profile.

M5 [U]: The saved primary-source review was unavailable or could not establish one dataset release; inventory-only claims were not promoted to supported evidence. No concrete transformations or explicit unprocessed-data statement are established.
